description: React component for a quick channel switch modal in Mattermost, including suggestion handling, UI rendering, and channel switching logic.

classes.name: QuickSwitchModal
classes.description: React component class for the quick switch modal, managing state, rendering UI, and handling user interactions.

methods.name: focusTextbox
methods.description: Focuses the suggestion box input textbox and places the caret at the end.

methods.name: setSwitchBoxRef
methods.description: Sets the reference to the suggestion box component and focuses the textbox.

methods.name: hideOnSelect
methods.description: Handles UI updates and state reset when a suggestion is selected.

methods.name: focusPostTextbox
methods.description: Focuses the main post textbox if not on mobile.

methods.name: hideOnCancel
methods.description: Handles modal dismissal and refocuses the origin element.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Updates component state with user input and shows loading spinner.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles submission of selected suggestion, switching channels or navigating.

methods.name: handleSuggestionsReceived
methods.description: Processes received suggestions, updates loading state and suggestion list.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the modal UI with suggestion box and related components.
